commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+9' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
90+7' The corner is swung in but Las Palmas can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+6' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Juan Soriano stops the ball from going into the top of the net. Las Palmas will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+3' 2 - 1 Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) unleashes a ferocious shot from just outside the penalty area and the ball goes into the left side of the goal!
90+3' Leganes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+2' Leganes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Leganes can continue in their attacking effort.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
87' Luis Carrion has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) replacing Kirian Rodriguez.
87' Borja Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Oscar Rodriguez will be replaced by Adria Altimira (Leganes).
85' 2 - 0 Enric Franquesa (Leganes) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom right corner, leaving the keeper helpless.
82' The substitution is prepared. Enric Franquesa (Leganes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Seydouba Cisse.
82' We are about to witness a substitution. Diego Garcia (Leganes) is replacing Miguel de la Fuente.
78' Luis Carrion has decided to make a change. Jaime Mata replaces Alex Munoz (Las Palmas).
78' Today's match ends for Marvin (Las Palmas) who will be replaced by Sandro Ramirez.
77' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) sends a cross into the box, but Juan Soriano comes off his line to gather the ball.
76' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.

76' CHANCE! Valentin Rosier (Leganes) receives a brilliant pass and finds himself one-on-one with Jasper Cillessen, who reacts superbly to stop him. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
74' Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The linesman signals a throw-in for Leganes.
74' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Renato Tapia (Leganes) and blew his whistle.

71' 1 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Juan Cruz (Leganes) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top left corner. Jasper Cillessen just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:0.
71' Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Juan Soriano intercepts the ball.
68' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
67' Leganes keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
66' Luis Carrion has decided to substitute Alberto Moleiro and he is replaced by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas).
65' Viti (Las Palmas) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alex Suarez.
65' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
64' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Marvin (Las Palmas). A free kick to Leganes.
63' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
63' The ball is cleared after Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Las Palmas will have a chance to score from a corner.
62' Here is a change. Dani Raba is going off and Borja Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Juan Cruz (Leganes).
62' The referee allows time for a substitution. Darko Brasanac will be replaced by Renato Tapia (Leganes).
60' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jasper Cillessen, who smothers the ball.
59' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

59' Marvin (Las Palmas) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The referee blows his whistle, Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.

58' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea with no other option than to blow for a foul.
54' Penalty saved! Dani Raba (Leganes) sends the penalty towards the left hand side of the goal, but Jasper Cillessen pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
54' Dani Raba (Leganes) is going to take the penalty!
52' Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) is penalised for holding. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea signals a set piece. The referee blows his whistle and awards Leganes a penalty after chaos inside the box.

51' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball has crossed the sideline. Las Palmas are taking a throw-in.
51' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) is adjudged offside.
48' Dani Raba (Leganes) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
48' A cross from Javi Hernandez (Leganes) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
47' The attendance for today's match is 10052.

46' The cross into the penalty area from Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) tries to find Miguel de la Fuente, but he puts too much power on the pass.
45+2' The foul by Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea.
45+2' Marvin (Las Palmas) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
45+1' Dani Raba (Leganes) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
42' Great touch by Dani Raba (Leganes) as he receives a precise pass deep in the box. He rips a snap shot and the ball bounces off the goalkeeper's gloves and hits the post.
42' Marvin (Las Palmas) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Alberto Moleiro. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
41' Some patient build-up play from Las Palmas as they look to unlock the defence.
39' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea shows a yellow card to Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) for a tough tackle.
38' Las Palmas can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

37' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the bottom right corner, but he can't get the power to direct it past Juan Soriano, who gets down to save. Las Palmas will take a corner kick.
35' Las Palmas failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
35' Marvin (Las Palmas) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Las Palmas force a corner. They send men into the box.
31' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
29' Some great controlled play and passing from Leganes. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) commits a rough challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for an infringement.
21' Alex Munoz (Las Palmas) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
21' A corner kick by Las Palmas is thwarted by the well prepared Juan Soriano (Leganes).
20' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) is easily saved by Juan Soriano. The ball goes out of play. Las Palmas are awarded a corner kick.
19' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Leganes.
19' A first-time shot by Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players. It will be a corner kick for Leganes.
17' Dani Raba (Leganes) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for an infringement.
15' Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
15' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle. Darko Brasanac (Leganes) commits a foul after dangerous play.
14' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) commits a rough challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.

11' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
6' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) is put clear inside the box by a lofted pass. He only has the keeper to beat, but Juan Soriano comes out bravely to save at his feet. Great goalkeeping skills!
3' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) commits a rough foul. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea stops the game and makes a call.
3' Leganes players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
2' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Las Palmas will have the kick-off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea was nominated as the referee for this game.
